title: Kalshi pauses operations in Utah, where it has 177K+ users, citing a federal court loss over a state gambling law; Kalshi also faces criminal charges in Utah (Alixel Cabrera/Utah News Dispatch)
summary: Alixel Cabrera / Utah News Dispatch: Kalshi pauses operations in Utah, where it has 177K+ users, citing a federal court loss over a state gambling law; Kalshi also faces criminal charges in Utah — Amid multiple legal disputes between Utah leaders and Kalshi, the prediction market platform has paused operations in the state.
